candidates.title: Consensus-Gated Execution (CGX): Bull/Bear debate + Meta-Evaluator gating
candidates.notes: Confirmed via grep as a genuine non-duplicate (zero hits for 'electronics15153453', 'Consensus-Gated Execution', 'CGX' anywhere in wiki/ or dream_cycle/). Published within the last ~2 weeks. Reports OOS Sharpe 1.90, MaxDD -11.6%, ~3x trend-following baseline, validated across a 52-week 2024 run and a 417-session 2022-2025 multi-regime run. WebFetch on the MDPI page returned HTTP 403 (site blocks the fetch tool); detail gathered via WebSearch fallback at abstract/search-result granularity only, noted honestly rather than invented. Distinguishing feature vs our existing H274 (3-agent advocate/skeptic/judge debate, always votes) and H461 TrustTrade (embedding-based post-hoc consensus gate, arXiv:2603.22567): CGX's Meta-Evaluator produces zero trades as a first-class output when the Bull/Bear debate doesn't converge, rather than filtering after a vote already happened. Staged at dream_cycle/staged/2026-08-18/1_cgx_multiagent_consensus_gate_wiki.json as a wiki research-lead note (risk_level low, no hypothesis number assigned -- crypto-domain result, would need translation work to backtest against our PEAD/8-K domain, and only abstract-level numbers are available pending full-text access).
